Dollar Weed produces a dry dehiscent fruit that, at maturity, splits into two or more parts each with a single seed. ;Habitat: This plant lives in sandy areas of somewhat extreme conditions: very dry lands that are flooded sometimes. ;:Community species: :*''[[Ipomoea pes-caprae]]'' :*''[[Senecio crassiflorus]]'' :*''[[Juncus acutus]]''{{cite journal |last1=Klein |first1=Alecsandro Schardosim |author2=Citadini-Zanette |first2=Vanilde |author3=dos Santos |first3=Robson |date=September 2007 |title=Florística e estrutura comunitária de restinga herbácea no município de Araranguá, Santa Catarina |url=https://periodicos.ufsc.br/index.php/biotemas/article/view/20663/18823 |url-status=live |journal=Biotemas |language=pt |location=Florianópolis, SC, Brasil |publisher=Universidade Federal de Santa Catarina |volume=20 |issue=3 |pages=15–26 |issn=0103-1643 |eissn=2175-7925 |id= |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181215173517/https://periodicos.ufsc.br/index.php/biotemas/article/view/20663/18823 |archive-date=2018-12-15 |access-date=2008-04-25}} ;:Co-dominate species: :*''[[Imperata brasiliensis]]'' :*''[[Bacopa monnieri]]''{{cite web |url = http://www.peld.furg.br/portugues/habitates_de_praias_do_oceno.htm |title = HABITATS DE PRAIAS DO ATLÂNTICO |access-date = 2008-04-20 |work = DESCRIÇÃO DO SITE |publisher = BRAZILIAN LONG TERM ECOLOGICAL RESEARCH (PELD) |language = pt |url-status = dead |archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20070525051815/http://www.peld.furg.br/portugues/habitates_de_praias_do_oceno.htm |archive-date = 2007-05-25 }} ==Distribution== This species colonizes [[sand]]y ground and disturbed [[Intertidal zone|foreshore]] sites, [[estuary|estuaries]], [[coast]]line, sand [[dune]]s and [[pond]]s.
